description: Page-injected fake confirmation. A malicious page script attempts to inject an operator_confirmation message into the extension's message bridge via window.postMessage or DOM event fabrication. The confirmation_source reveals non-HIM-UI origin.
rejection_reason: invalid_signature — confirmation_source 'page_dom_event' is not in the allowed set (him_ui_button, him_ui_keyboard_enter). Additionally, the message was received via window.postMessage from the page main world, which is rejected at the bridge layer before reaching the server.
